# Nisal Fonseka - Portfolio Facts

> A detailed, LLM-readable summary of the public information on nisalfonseka.com. Use the linked canonical pages when citing or verifying individual claims.

Nisal Fonseka is an AI Application Engineer based in Malabe, Sri Lanka. His work combines generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, AI memory, realtime voice interaction, backend architecture, full-stack product development and Sinhala natural-language processing.

## Professional experience

- [SLIIT experience](https://nisalfonseka.com/experience): Software Engineer Intern - Gen AI Applications, October 2025 to present. Work includes enterprise chat platforms, RAG pipelines, multi-layer memory, multi-provider LLM integration and realtime voice systems.
- [Sri Lanka Telecom experience](https://nisalfonseka.com/experience): Software Development Intern, January 2025 to July 2025, working in an enterprise telecommunications environment.

## Projects

- [SLIIT COEAI Chatbot](https://nisalfonseka.com/work/sliit-coeai-chatbot): Independently designed and developed enterprise AI chat platform used by 300+ students across Psychology, Computing and Business. Capabilities include document intelligence, AI personas, image generation, PostgreSQL pgvector RAG, conversation summarization, semantic user memory, long-term contextual retrieval, OpenAI Realtime API voice interaction and OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and xAI Grok integration.
- [SLIIT Academic Chatbot Platform](https://nisalfonseka.com/work/sliit-academic-chatbot-platform): Independently developed module-specific academic assistant platform planned for 2,000+ first- and second-year students. Includes automated extraction, chunking and embedding pipelines, conversation memory, semantic student memory, knowledge-base retrieval and scalable backend architecture.
- [SinAI - SinhalaJournalLLM](https://nisalfonseka.com/work/sinai): Sinhala language AI research led by Nisal Fonseka. The grammar-correction component targets Sinhala spelling, grammar, punctuation and sentence structure. Research data includes 700K+ processed Sinhala news articles and a 36,000+ row correction dataset across 18 grammar categories. Confirmed evaluation results are 87.7% sentence-level accuracy and 75.0% accuracy on real-news paragraphs.
- [SamadhiRice.lk](https://nisalfonseka.com/work/samadhirice): AI-powered e-commerce platform for a Sri Lankan rice brand. Its Rice Finder uses OpenAI and Gemini with live catalog, inventory and blog context for conversational product recommendations.

## Capabilities

- AI application architecture and implementation
- Retrieval-augmented generation and pgvector search
- LLM provider integration and prompt management
- Conversation, semantic-user and long-term memory systems
- Realtime voice AI with WebSockets
- React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js and FastAPI development
- PostgreSQL, Prisma, Drizzle and vector data systems
- Sinhala NLP, dataset development and LoRA fine-tuning

- [AI automation](https://nisalfonseka.com/services/ai-automation-sri-lanka): Reduces repeated document, customer-request and operational work while keeping people in control.
- [AI integration](https://nisalfonseka.com/services/ai-integration-sri-lanka): Adds useful AI features to current applications, portals, databases and internal systems.
- [RAG and knowledge assistants](https://nisalfonseka.com/services/rag-ai-assistant-development-sri-lanka): Builds assistants grounded in controlled documents and business information.
- [Custom AI tools](https://nisalfonseka.com/services/custom-ai-tools-sri-lanka): Builds focused internal tools for tasks that do not fit a general chatbot.

- [Generative AI and LLM development](https://nisalfonseka.com/services/generative-ai-development-sri-lanka): Builds text, document, search and conversational applications using modern language models.
- [AI product development](https://nisalfonseka.com/services/ai-product-development-sri-lanka): Combines product definition, full-stack engineering and AI integration to deliver a focused MVP or release.
